_purpose: During the acts (R11, C21). Approved by David 12 October 2026 (design docs/design/2026-10-12-foyer-performance-card-and-pip-design.md section 4). Differs from the engine's built-in cards only by the bar sentence on act two - SiL's postshow keeps the bar open.
_times_note: Times come from performances.json. Every SiL interval/finish estimate is null until S4, so at the theatre the 'running' card shows; on the preview site the act cards show a 'time to be confirmed' chip.
_foh_check: Confirm with FoH (Nicol / Dave C) before the run that 'shown in at a suitable moment' is the latecomer practice.

items.headline: Act One is under way
items.body: The interval is at about {interval_at}. Latecomers will be shown in at a suitable moment.

items.headline: Act Two is under way
items.body: The performance ends at about {finish_at}. The bar stays open afterwards.
